newsitem.title: USA: Airborne to open expanded N.Jersey facility.
newsitem.headline: Airborne to open expanded N.Jersey facility.

text.p: Airborne Express said it would open a new international service centre and gateway in Elizabeth, New Jersey on June 1.

The new facility will add 25,000 sq ft to the existing 60,000 sq ft domestic service centre and will also provide improved handling for the 100 tonnes of cargo passing monthly through Newark International airport, Airborne's International regional service manager, George Heino told Reuters.

Airborne may also move handling cargo intended for Britain to Elizabeth from its John F. Kennedy facility in order to be closer to Newark. "That would make up an additional 100 tonnes of cargo per month," he added.
Port Authority of New York and New Jersey figures show that air cargo handled at Newark in 1996 rose by 12.3 percent over the previous year, a rise of some 90,000 tonnes.
